remarks: Welcome to Penthouse A at the hi-rise building of Washington Mews downtown Stamford, CT. Open concept space with PLENTY of closet/storage/cabinets. Freshly painted! Light, bright, clean and updated for your comfort. Commuter friendly! Views of Scalzi Park. Located just minutes from major highways, train stations, Parks & MORE! Grand selection of shopping, restaurants and bars nearby. Unit has been well maintained, owner occupied since 2017. This top floor unit has city views perfect for all including those working remotely. Includes 1 commodious bedroom with walk-in closet, 1 full bathroom, 1 half bath, living room, dining area, EIK, balcony off of kitchen area & WASHER/DRYER IN UNIT. HOA also includes access to in-ground pool and (3) total covered garage spaces. Mail room and lobby/meeting area with couches on main level. Pool open from Memorial Day-Labor Day. Building secure. Callbox in rear entrance. Low HOA. No known upcoming assesments. No known rental restrictions. 1 Pet per unit allowed. Building financially in good standing with reserves/budget. Internet HI-SPEED included in monthly HOA. See agent remarks for updates.
